parameters.query:
SELECT
  i.job_id AS requested_job_id,
  j.id AS job_id,
  j.topic,
  j.language_code,
  j.target_duration_seconds,
  j.status,
  j.current_stage,
  j.id IS NOT NULL AS job_exists,
  (j.status='created' AND j.current_stage='intake') AS eligible
FROM (SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id) i
LEFT JOIN public.jobs j ON j.id=i.job_id;

jsonb_array_length(i.story_package->'assets')=jsonb_array_length(i.story_package->'units') AND COALESCE((i.duration_preflight->>'exact_tts_required')::boolean,false)=true AND COALESCE((i.duration_preflight->>'prediction_is_advisory')::boolean,false)=true AND (SELECT count(*) FROM valid)=(SELECT jsonb_array_length(i.evidence_json))), ins AS (INSERT INTO public.job_evidence(job_id,evidence_id,source_id,source_language,source_title,source_url,passage_id,section,evidence_text,selection_score,selection_rank) SELECT o.id,v.evidence_id,v.source_id,v.source_language,v.source_title,NULLIF(v.source_url,''),v.passage_id,NULLIF(v.section,''),v.evidence_text,v.selection_score,v.selection_rank FROM ok o CROSS JOIN valid v ORDER BY v.selection_rank RETURNING job_id), upd AS (UPDATE public.jobs j SET content_model_version='staged_v1',topic_resolution=i.topic_resolution,story_package=i.story_package,visual_search_queries_en=NULL,script_text=i.script_text,script_support=i.script_support,duration_preflight=i.duration_preflight,narration_engine=i.narration_engine,narration_model=i.narration_model,narration_prompt_version=i.narration_prompt_version,script_fit_passes=i.script_fit_passes,fact_source_language=i.fact_source_language,fact_primary_title=i.fact_primary_title,status='processing',current_stage='script',last_error=NULL,updated_at=now() FROM input i,ok o WHERE j.id=o.id AND j.id=i.job_id RETURNING j.id) SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM ins) inserted_evidence_count,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM upd) job_updated,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.scenes s WHERE s.job_id=$1::uuid) scene_count,(SELECT jsonb_array_length(story_package->'units') FROM public.jobs WHERE id=$1::uuid) story_unit_count;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json,p=$('Build Final Inventory Story').first().json,expected=p.selected_evidence.length,units=p.story_package.units.length;if(r.job_updated!==true)throw new Error(`inventory-first story did not update job ${p.job_id}`);if(Number(r.inserted_evidence_count)!==expected)throw new Error(`evidence persisted ${r.inserted_evidence_count}/${expected}`);if(Number(r.scene_count)!==0)throw new Error('WF02 must not create timed scenes before TTS');if(Number(r.story_unit_count)!==units)throw new Error(`story package persisted ${r.story_unit_count}/${units} units`);return [{json:{job_id:p.job_id,evidence_count:expected,story_unit_count:units,narration_ready:true}}];
